objective: Implement deterministic point-in-time Data Replay over canonical P06-G ReplaySnapshot inputs so the exact historical event stream can be reconstructed for later P19-C Decision Replay without introducing decision, fill, routing or execution authority.
scope: Consume canonical P06-G ReplaySnapshot and preserve its snapshot identity
Replay dataset events only when visible under ReplaySnapshot.view_at anti-lookahead semantics
Bind every replay event to exact dataset name/version, entity, event time, availability time and source evidence SHA-256
Reject unknown dataset versions, events outside replay windows, future availability, duplicate sequence/event identity and non-monotonic canonical ordering
Support deterministic replay through an explicit simulated decision time
Produce a content-addressed replay result containing the ordered emitted event identities
Preserve clock-mode and point-in-time provenance for P19-C consumption
out_of_scope: Order creation, fills or capital authority
dependencies: Owner P19 phase authorization GRANTED / CONSUMED
tests: Same ReplaySnapshot and event set produce identical replay result identity
Input order cannot change canonical replay result
Event outside snapshot/dataset window fails closed
Future-available event is withheld until visible
Duplicate sequence or duplicate event identity fails closed
Replay through time emits only point-in-time visible events
P19-B evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No order submission or fill generation
rollback: Revert P19-B data replay package/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P19-A remains canonical complete and P19-C remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
